The Copernicus DEM 30-m was produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30  DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and  Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved. For additional information, please refer to https://doi.org/10.5067/NIDEM-1 and https://doi.org/10.5270/ESA-c5d3d65.
auxiliary_inputs.water_mask: Water Mask for the NASA-ISRO NISAR mission version 0.5, derived through analysis and processing of multiple input datasets, referenced to the WGS84 ellipsoid. Water mask derived at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, under contract with NASA, using multiple open datasets: JRC Global Surface Water v1.3 (Pekel et al 2016, Nature 540, 418-422,  EC JRC/Google); ESA WorldCover 10 m 2020 ( ESA WorldCover project 2020 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium); OpenStreetMap Water Polygons ( OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0); MEaSUREs GIMP Mask v1 (Howat 2017, doi:10.5067/B8X58MQBFUPA; Howat et al 2014).
